[SWS_TcpIp_00216]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00087
⌈The service TcpIp_ResetIpAssignment() shall reset all persistently stored IP
addresses in the NvMBlock (see [[ECUC_TcpIp_00184]]) to invalid values (e.g.
to
0.0.0.0 for IPv4 addresses).⌋
Note: The next time the TcpIpAddrAssignment configured with TCPIP_STORE are
started, the related address assignment method are started to obtain new IP ad-
dresses.
